searches.topic: LLM Agent for Automated PCB Design

papers.title: ChipNeMo: Domain-Adapted LLMs for Chip Design
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 首次系统证明领域适配预训练（芯片设计语料 + RLHF）可大幅提升 LLM 在 EDA 脚本生成、工程助手、Bug 分析三类任务上的表现，ChipNeMo-70B 超越 GPT-4；为后续 PCB/硬件设计 LLM 的领域适配技术路线奠定实证基础
papers.summary_en: ChipNeMo applies domain-adaptive tokenization, continued pretraining on internal chip design corpora, and instruction-tuning aligned with EDA expert knowledge to produce a family of models (13B–70B). Tested on three internal applications—engineering chatbot, Tcl/Python EDA script generation, and bug report analysis—the 70B variant outperforms GPT-4 on two of three tasks. The work demonstrates that domain adaptation, not raw model size, is the key lever for hardware-design LLMs, motivating the field-wide shift toward specialized pretraining data pipelines.
papers.summary_zh: ChipNeMo 对 LLaMA 系列模型进行领域自适应分词、芯片设计语料继续预训练和领域专属指令对齐，构建了 13B 和 70B 两款模型。在三项内部任务（GPU 工程助手聊天、EDA Tcl/Python 脚本生成、Bug 分析）中，ChipNeMo-70B 在工程助手和脚本生成两项上超越 GPT-4，Bug 分析接近。本文证明对于硬件设计场景，领域适配比单纯扩大模型规模更关键，成为后续 PCB/EDA 领域模型研究（ChipBench、VerilogEval 等）的重要参照起点。

papers.title: ChatEDA: A Large Language Model Powered Autonomous Agent for EDA
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 首个 LLM 驱动的完整 EDA 自主 Agent，通过微调的 AutoMage 模型实现从 RTL 到 GDSII 的自然语言任务分解→脚本生成→工具调用闭环，建立了 LLM-Agent-for-EDA 的技术范式；此后 PCB 设计自动化论文均以此为基础范式
papers.summary_en: ChatEDA introduces an autonomous EDA agent where a fine-tuned LLM (AutoMage) serves as the central controller, receiving natural-language design goals and decomposing them into subtasks dispatched to commercial EDA tools (OpenROAD, Yosys, etc.). The system closes the RTL-to-GDSII loop without manual script editing. AutoMage, derived from CodeLlama with EDA-specific instruction tuning, outperforms GPT-4 on design-script-generation benchmarks. First presented at MLCAD 2023; expanded journal version published in IEEE TCAD 2024.
papers.summary_zh: ChatEDA 以微调的 AutoMage（基于 CodeLlama 的 EDA 指令微调版本）为核心控制器，接收自然语言设计目标，自动分解为子任务并调用 OpenROAD、Yosys 等 EDA 工具，实现 RTL→GDSII 无需人工干预的闭环设计流程。AutoMage 在脚本生成任务上优于 GPT-4。本文在 MLCAD 2023 首次提出后扩展为 IEEE TCAD 2024 期刊版，是 LLM EDA Agent 领域的奠基性工作，直接启发了 PCB 级自动化 Agent 的设计范式。

papers.title: LaMAGIC: Language-Model-based Topology Generation for Analog Integrated Circuits
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 首个将模拟电路拓扑生成建模为语言模型序列生成任务的工作，单次前向推理从自然语言规格生成完整电路拓扑；为 NL→电路结构生成范式在 PCB 层面的延伸（PCBSchemaGen、SchGen 等）奠定方法基础
papers.summary_en: LaMAGIC frames analog IC topology generation as a sequence-to-sequence problem, fine-tuning a transformer-based LM to map functional specifications (in natural language) to circuit netlist-like token sequences in a single pass. Evaluated on opamp and voltage regulator topologies, it outperforms random search and GNN baselines in both validity and target-spec satisfaction. Presented at ICML 2024; extended by LaMAGIC2 (TODAES) in 2025 with richer circuit formulations.
papers.summary_zh: LaMAGIC 将模拟集成电路拓扑生成建模为序列到序列任务，通过监督微调 Transformer 语言模型，单次推理将自然语言功能规格映射为电路连接表 Token 序列。在运算放大器和稳压器拓扑生成上优于随机搜索和图神经网络基线，在规格满足率和电路有效率指标上均有显著提升。以 ICML 2024 发表，后续 LaMAGIC2（TODAES 2025）进一步丰富了电路表示形式。该范式直接启发了 PCBSchemaGen 和 SchGen 等 PCB 板级原理图生成工作。

papers.title: A Survey of Research in Large Language Models for Electronic Design Automation
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 涵盖 102 篇 LLM+EDA 研究（70 篇已发表 + 32 篇高质量预印本）的综合综述，系统梳理模型架构、定制技术（RAG/微调/提示工程）和应用领域，是理解 PCB 设计自动化在整个 EDA-LLM 生态中定位的最佳入口
papers.summary_en: This TODAES survey covers 102 papers (70 peer-reviewed + 32 quality preprints) on LLMs for EDA, spanning system-level design, RTL generation, logic synthesis, physical design (including PCB-layer work), and verification. It taxonomizes customization techniques into fine-tuning, RAG, and prompting families, and identifies open challenges in data scarcity, hallucination for safety-critical constraints, and multi-tool agent orchestration. Authored by researchers from Duke and Texas A&M universities.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述覆盖 LLM+EDA 领域 102 篇文献（70 篇已发表、32 篇高质量预印本），从系统级设计、RTL 生成、逻辑综合、物理设计（含板级 PCB 工作）到验证全流程进行系统梳理。将定制化技术分为微调、RAG 和提示工程三类，指出数据稀缺、安全约束幻觉和多工具 Agent 协同是核心开放挑战。由 Duke 大学和德克萨斯 A&M 联合撰写，发表于 ACM TODAES 2025，是进入该领域的必读综述。
papers.topic: LLM Agent for Automated PCB Design

papers.title: AnalogCoder: Analog Circuit Design via Training-Free Code Generation
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 将模拟电路设计建模为 Python 代码生成问题，无需微调即可用 GPT-4 等通用 LLM 设计电路并通过仿真反馈自我修正；代码生成+仿真反馈+工具库复用的三元范式被 PCBSchemaGen、SchGen 等 PCB 级论文直接继承
papers.summary_en: AnalogCoder reformulates analog circuit design as Python code generation, enabling training-free use of general-purpose LLMs (tested on GPT-4o). A feedback loop runs SPICE simulation on generated circuits, parses error messages, and prompts the LLM to self-correct. A circuit tool library archives verified sub-circuit templates for reuse in composite designs. On a benchmark of 20 analog tasks, AnalogCoder surpasses GPT-4o baseline by 5 circuits. Accepted as an AAAI 2025 Oral presentation.
papers.summary_zh: AnalogCoder 将模拟电路设计重新建模为 Python 代码合成任务，无需任何微调即可驱动 GPT-4o 等通用 LLM 生成电路代码。系统自动运行 SPICE 仿真，解析错误反馈并提示 LLM 迭代修正；同时维护一个已验证子电路模板库供复合电路复用。在 20 个模拟电路任务 benchmark 上超越 GPT-4o 基线 5 题，以 AAAI 2025 Oral 发表。该代码生成+仿真验证+库复用范式被后续 PCB 原理图生成工作（PCBSchemaGen、SchGen）直接移植至板级设计。

papers.title: AutoCircuit-RL: Reinforcement Learning-Driven LLM for Automated Circuit Topology Generation
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 在 LLM 指令微调基础上加入 RL 奖励优化阶段，通过奖励模型评估拓扑有效性、效率和目标电压约束，将有效电路生成率提升 ~12%、重复生成率降低 ~38%；双阶段 RL+LLM 范式为 PCB 设计引入可微分设计约束优化思路
papers.summary_en: AutoCircuit-RL trains LLMs for circuit topology generation in two phases: instruction tuning on structured prompts encoding design constraints, then RL refinement using reward models evaluating validity, efficiency, and output-voltage compliance. Compared to pure supervised baselines, the RL stage yields ~12% more valid circuits, ~14% efficiency improvement, and ~38% fewer duplicates. Presented as a poster at ICML 2025. From IBM Research; code available on GitHub.
papers.summary_zh: AutoCircuit-RL 分两阶段训练用于电路拓扑生成的 LLM：首先在编码设计约束的结构化 Prompt 上进行指令微调，其次通过 RL 奖励模型（评估拓扑有效性、效率、输出电压合规性）进行强化学习精调。相比纯监督基线，RL 阶段带来约 12% 有效电路提升、约 14% 效率提升和约 38% 重复生成率下降。以 ICML 2025 Poster 发表，来自 IBM Research。双阶段范式为在 PCB 原理图生成中引入可学习约束验证提供了方法参考。
papers.topic: LLM Agent for Automated PCB Design

papers.title: The Dawn of Agentic EDA: A Survey of Autonomous Digital Chip Design
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 将 Agentic EDA 建模为约束神经符号优化问题，提出感知-认知-行动三层 Cognitive Stack 分类法；全面覆盖前端（RTL→逻辑综合）到后端（布局布线）的自主 Agent 系统，直接对标 PCB 设计自动化 Agent 的能力层级
papers.summary_en: This survey reframes Agentic EDA as a Constrained Neuro-Symbolic Optimization problem rather than mere tool-calling. It proposes a Cognitive Stack taxonomy (Perception / Cognition / Action layers) to classify autonomous chip design systems, analyzes front-end (RTL repair, dual-loop verification) vs. back-end (algorithm-centric vs. agent-centric floorplanning) approaches, and identifies trustworthiness gaps motivating Sim-to-Silicon benchmarks and formal grounding. Submitted December 2025; covers systems through early 2026.
papers.summary_zh: 本综述将 Agentic EDA 重新建模为约束神经符号优化问题，提出感知（Perception）—认知（Cognition）—行动（Action）三层 Cognitive Stack 分类法，系统分析前端（RTL 双环修复、验证自主化）与后端（算法中心 vs Agent 中心布局）的最新自主系统。明确指出当前 LLM-based Agent 尚未完成工业级无人监督 tape-out，并提出 Sim-to-Silicon benchmark 和形式化接地的研究议程。2025 年 12 月提交，覆盖至 2026 年初的最新系统。

papers.title: IoTGen: Towards LLM-Driven IoT Hardware PCB Generation
papers.authors: Qinpei Luo, Ruichun Ma, Xinyu Zhang, Lili Qiu
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 首个面向 IoT 场景的端到端 LLM 驱动 PCB 生成系统，从自然语言需求出发直接输出 IoT 硬件 PCB 设计；以 MobiSys 2026 Emerging Ideas 发表，代表移动系统顶会对 NL→硬件自动化方向的最新背书
papers.summary_en: IoTGen is an agentic system that generates IoT PCB designs directly from natural language descriptions of hardware requirements, targeting the full pipeline from component selection through schematic generation. It is the first IoT-community paper at a top mobile systems venue (MobiSys 2026) to treat PCB generation as an LLM task. The work is from the UCSD/MSR/UT Austin group (Luo, Ma, Zhang, Qiu), the same group that produced SchGen. Published in the Emerging Ideas track of MobiSys 2026.
papers.summary_zh: IoTGen 是首个面向 IoT 场景的 LLM 驱动 PCB 生成 Agent 系统，从自然语言硬件需求出发，覆盖从元件选择到原理图生成的完整流程。作为 MobiSys 2026（移动系统顶会）Emerging Ideas 方向论文，是 IoT 社区首次正式将 PCB 设计自动化视为 LLM 任务。来自 UCSD/MSR/UT Austin 联合团队（同 SchGen 作者）。目前无 arXiv 预印本，PDF 可从 ACM DL 获取。
papers.topic: LLM Agent for Automated PCB Design

papers.title: PCB-Bench: Benchmarking LLMs for Printed Circuit Board Placement and Routing
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 首个系统评测 LLM 在 PCB 布局布线上的综合 benchmark（文本推理 3700 题 + 多模态 500 题 + 真实设计 174 项），以 ICLR 2026 顶会发表，清晰量化当前 LLM 在 PCB 工程约束推理上的能力缺口，为后续研究提供标准评测基准
papers.summary_en: PCB-Bench is the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating LLMs and MLLMs on PCB placement and routing tasks, contributed by HKUST (Guangzhou). It spans three task settings: text-based reasoning (~3,700 QA pairs covering design rule compliance, component placement, routing strategies), multimodal image-text reasoning (~500 problems with PCB layout images), and real-world design comprehension (174 complete OSHWHub projects). Results show current models struggle with engineering constraint reasoning and spatial interpretation of PCB layouts. Published at ICLR 2026.
papers.summary_zh: PCB-Bench 是首个系统评测 LLM/MLLM 在 PCB 布局布线上的综合 benchmark，来自香港科技大学（广州）。包含三类任务：文本推理（约 3700 道专家标注题，覆盖设计规则合规、元件放置、布线策略）、多模态图文推理（约 500 题，需联合理解 PCB 版图图像与技术规格）和真实设计理解（174 个完整 OSHWHub 项目）。实验显示当前模型在工程约束推理和版图空间理解上存在显著差距。以 ICLR 2026 会议论文发表，是 PCB AI 设计领域的重要评测基准。
papers.topic: LLM Agent for Automated PCB Design

papers.title: HWE-Bench: Can Language Models Perform Board-level Schematic Designs?
papers.authors: Weibo Qiu, Yinhao Xiao, Runyu Pan
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 首个专注板级原理图设计的 LLM 评测 benchmark，300 条来自 GitHub/OSHWLab 的真实任务，2914 份 IC 数据手册支撑；揭示当前最佳模型板级设计 pass rate 仅 8.15%，清晰标定了当前技术边界与差距
papers.summary_en: HWE-Bench introduces 300 board-level schematic design tasks sourced from GitHub and OSHWHub, covering 8 application domains and backed by 2,914 IC datasheets. Models receive functional requirements and component specs, generate schematics, and are validated through electrical rule checks and circuit simulation. The top-performing model achieves only 8.15% overall pass rate, revealing that while LLMs handle documentation well, they lack physical circuit intuition required for correct board-level design.
papers.summary_zh: HWE-Bench 收录 300 条来自 GitHub 和 OSHWHub 的板级原理图设计任务，覆盖 8 个应用领域，辅以 2914 份 IC 数据手册。模型输入功能需求和元件规格，输出原理图，通过电气规则检查和电路仿真双重验证。当前最佳模型整体 pass rate 仅 8.15%，揭示 LLM 虽然能处理文档理解类任务，但在物理电路设计中仍缺乏必要的电气直觉。该 benchmark 与 PCB-Bench 互补，共同标定了当前技术边界。
papers.topic: LLM Agent for Automated PCB Design

papers.title: PCBSchemaGen: Reward-Guided LLM Code Synthesis for PCB Schematic Design with Structured Verification
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 将 PCB 原理图生成建模为代码合成，用 5 层确定性连续奖励验证器（引脚级错误定位）替代传统单元测试，227 个真实 IC 任务上实现 81.3% pass rate；推理时自动修正机制无需微调即可适配任意 IC 型号
papers.summary_en: PCBSchemaGen frames PCB schematic generation as code synthesis with a 5-layer deterministic continuous-reward verifier that provides pin-level error localization without requiring reference solutions. Tested on 227 real-IC tasks across two benchmarks (including novel ICs unseen during development), Gemma-4-31B achieves 81.3% pass rate, demonstrating cross-benchmark generalization. The reward verifier validates against physical constraints extracted from IC datasheets, enabling inference-time self-repair for any IC without retraining.
papers.summary_zh: PCBSchemaGen 将 PCB 原理图生成建模为代码合成问题，核心创新是 5 层确定性连续奖励验证器：可对生成代码提供引脚级错误定位，无需参考答案，也无需单元测试。在 227 个真实 IC 任务（跨两个 benchmark）上，Gemma-4-31B 实现 81.3% pass rate，并在新型 IC 上展示了跨 benchmark 的泛化能力。验证器从 IC 数据手册提取物理约束，使推理时自动修正循环可适配任意 IC 型号，无需重新训练。
papers.topic: LLM Agent for Automated PCB Design

papers.title: SchGen: PCB Schematic Generation with Semantic-Grounded Code Representations
papers.authors: Qinpei Luo, Ruichun Ma, Xinyu Zhang, Lili Qiu
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 将 PCB 原理图从几何重表示转化为语义化代码表示，大幅降低 LLM 生成难度；通过人-Agent 协作 pipeline 构建大规模开源硬件数据集，连接精度和功能正确性均超越更大规模通用模型；同一团队 IoTGen 的技术深化版
papers.summary_en: SchGen identifies that existing PCB schematic formats (KiCad, Altium) are geometry-heavy and tool-specific, making them poor targets for LLMs. It introduces a semantically grounded code representation that shifts the task from geometry to semantics. A human-agent collaborative pipeline converts open-source hardware designs to this representation, building a large-scale training dataset. Experiments show SchGen outperforms larger general-purpose models on connectivity accuracy and functional correctness. From the same UCSD/MSR/UT Austin group as IoTGen.
papers.summary_zh: SchGen 指出现有 PCB 原理图格式（KiCad、Altium 等）几何信息繁重、工具专属语法复杂，对 LLM 而言是低效的生成目标。论文提出语义化代码表示，将任务从几何定位转向电气语义，显著降低生成难度。通过人-Agent 协作数据 pipeline 将开源硬件设计（OSHWHub 等）转换为该表示，构建大规模训练集。实验在连接精度和功能正确性上均超越更大规模通用 LLM。来自与 IoTGen 相同的 UCSD/MSR/UT Austin 团队，是 IoTGen 的技术深化工作。
papers.topic: LLM Agent for Automated PCB Design

papers.title: CircuitLM: A Multi-Agent LLM-Aided Design Framework for Generating Circuit Schematics from Natural Language Prompts
papers.authors: Khandakar Shakib Al Hasan et al.
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 五阶段多 Agent pipeline（组件识别→引脚检索→推理→JSON 综合→可视化），用 embedding 驱动的元件库消解 LLM 幻觉；100 个电路 Prompt 上通过电气规则检查和语义评估双重验证，是 IEEE ICLAD（LLM+EDA 专会首届）代表性论文
papers.summary_en: CircuitLM proposes a five-stage multi-LLM pipeline for generating circuit schematics from natural language: component identification → pinout retrieval (from an embedding-powered component database) → design reasoning → CircuitJSON synthesis → visualization. The component database mitigates hallucination by grounding component references in real datasheets. Evaluated on 100 circuit design prompts using both deterministic electrical rule checking and LLM-based semantic evaluation across five state-of-the-art LLMs. Code and data publicly available.
papers.summary_zh: CircuitLM 提出五阶段多 LLM 流水线，将自然语言转化为电路原理图：组件识别→引脚检索（嵌入式驱动的元件数据库）→设计推理→CircuitJSON 合成→可视化。Embedding 驱动的元件库将 LLM 组件引用接地到真实数据手册，有效抑制幻觉。在 100 个电路设计 Prompt 上使用确定性电气规则检查和 LLM 语义评估双重验证，覆盖 5 款主流 LLM。代码和数据公开。以 IEEE ICLAD 2026（LLM+EDA 专会首届）发表。
papers.topic: LLM Agent for Automated PCB Design

papers.title: pcbGPT: Automatic PCB Schematic Synthesis from Natural Language Requirements
papers.authors: Tobias King, Steven Kehrberg, Michael Beigl, Tobias Röddiger
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 面向嵌入式系统的 KiCad PCB 原理图自动生成，集成工具调用、元件库搜索、数据手册知识和执行检查；20 个任务上 pass@1=0.90；提供可与 KiCad 实时同步的交互式 Web 工作流，来自德国 KIT，是欧洲视角的 PCB-LLM 系统
papers.summary_en: pcbGPT generates editable KiCad PCB schematics from natural-language specifications for embedded systems. It combines tool-augmented synthesis, component-library search, datasheet-grounded design knowledge, and execution-based checking through a Python circuit DSL. An interactive web workflow enables iterative refinement and real-time KiCad project synchronization. On 20 schematic tasks: pass@1 = 0.90, pass@5 = 1.00. Authors acknowledge the system is not yet reliable enough to replace expert review for final production designs. From Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT).
papers.summary_zh: pcbGPT 从自然语言规格生成可编辑的 KiCad PCB 原理图，面向嵌入式系统场景。系统集成工具调用、元件库搜索、数据手册知识和基于执行的合规检查，通过 Python 电路 DSL 表示设计。提供可与 KiCad 实时同步的交互式 Web 工作流，支持迭代精化。在 20 个原理图任务上 pass@1=0.90，pass@5=1.00。来自德国卡尔斯鲁厄理工学院（KIT），是欧洲研究视角的 PCB-LLM 系统代表。
papers.topic: LLM Agent for Automated PCB Design
